meta.title: Donate to Happy Paws
meta.description: Give a one-off or monthly gift to help Happy Paws rescue, care for and rehome cats in need.

s1.p: Every donation brings us one step closer to rescuing and rehabilitating cats in need. Your support helps provide food, shelter and medical care to the most vulnerable.
s1.p2: is what it costs, on average, to rehome one cat. Cats who need medical attention can cost considerably more.

list.li: Secure payment by card, plus Apple Pay and Google Pay where your device supports them.
A receipt is emailed to you after your gift.
Happy Paws is a registered charity run by dedicated volunteers.

s1.text2: Step 1 of 3: your gift. Then secure payment, then done.
s1.text3: How often would you like to give?
s1.text5: Regular support helps us plan ahead.
s1.p3: Monthly gifts come in set amounts. For any other amount, choose a one-off gift.
s1.p4: You'll complete your gift on a secure payment page.
s1.p5: Payments are taken by Stripe, a secure payment provider. Your card details never pass through our website.

s2.p: Here is what your support makes possible.

list.p: Good food, clean litter and a warm bed for every cat in our care.
Foster homes and shelter give cats somewhere safe to settle while they wait for their forever home.
Vet checks and treatment for cats who arrive in need of medical attention.

s3.p: Prefer not to give online? There are plenty of other ways to help.
s3.p2: Pay straight into our bank account, or set up a regular standing order.
s3.p3: We're always in need of supplies. Our wish list makes it easy to donate exactly what we need.
s3.p4: A cake sale, car boot, quiz night or coffee morning. We'd be overjoyed to hear your idea.
s3.p5: Give your time instead. Fostering gives cats a safe place to settle, and our volunteers keep everything running.

s4.p: Can't find what you need? Email us at [info@happypawscatrescue.org](mailto:info@happypawscatrescue.org).

list.question: Is my donation secure?
list.answer: Yes. Your payment is handled by a secure payment provider (Stripe), so your card details never pass through our website.

list.question: Can I change or cancel a monthly gift?
list.answer: Yes. Email us at info@happypawscatrescue.org and we will change or cancel it for you.

list.question: Will I get a receipt?
list.answer: Yes. A receipt is emailed to you after your gift. If it doesn't arrive, check your spam folder or email us.

list.question: Who are Happy Paws?
list.answer: We're a registered charity run by dedicated volunteers, based in Stockton, with foster homes in Birmingham and Banbury too.
